hook.name: AggHook
hook.description: An on-chain DEX aggregator hook for the USDC/USDT pair that intercepts swaps via beforeSwap, fetches real-time quotes from 4 Uniswap v4 pools and 2 Uniswap v3 pools, sorts them by effective price, and routes swaps through the best venues. Returns a BeforeSwapDelta to fully satisfy the swap amount without touching the hook's own v4 pool liquidity.
